title: Jumping Squares backup file (v1)
description: Shape (structural) schema for a Jumping Squares Save/Load backup file. This describes the file FORMAT only. It cannot express game-rule (semantic) validity such as point conservation, the turn-gate, the winner rule, or the no-mid-cascade rule - those are checked separately by tools/validate-rules.js, which runs the board through the game engine's loadState. A file that passes THIS schema is well-formed; a file whose BOARD section also passes validate-rules.js is ENGINE-valid (a legitimate, settled position the rules accept). Engine-valid is not identical to 'the current app will import it': the app's import also applies a UI dimension gate (today the fixed 5x5, 2-player board), so a valid board of another size passes validation but is refused on import until a board-size picker lands. Note on prefs: the app adopts the prefs section leniently (unknown or out-of-range fields are ignored and fall back to defaults rather than rejected), so this schema deliberately constrains prefs only to STRUCTURAL shape (container types), NOT to value enums - that keeps the 'passes schema => board is engine-valid' contract exact without flagging a prefs value the app would simply ignore.

format.description: Fixed tag identifying the file as a Jumping Squares backup.

formatVersion.description: Backup wrapper format version this schema describes.

engineVersion.description: The game build (VERSION) that wrote the file. Informational.

savedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the file was written. Informational.

board.description: Optional game-board section (present when 'Game board' was selected on export).

format.description: Fixed tag identifying the board section's envelope.

state.description: The engine board state (an engine cloneState snapshot).

turnsTaken.description: Per-player turn counts; index 0 unused, so length is players+1 (>= 3 for the minimum 2-player game). The exact length == players+1 is a cross-field rule the engine (validate-rules.js) enforces.

cells.description: Flat row-major array of cells; length must equal rows*cols (a cross-field rule the validator checks beyond this schema).

prefs.description: Optional settings & scores section (present when 'Settings & scores' was selected on export). Adopted LENIENTLY by the app field-by-field: unknown or out-of-range fields are ignored and fall back to defaults, never rejected. So this schema constrains prefs only to STRUCTURAL shape (the right container TYPES), not to value enums - a wrong value here (e.g. an unknown difficulty) is tolerated by the app, so flagging it would wrongly break the 'passes schema => board is engine-valid' contract.

v.description: Prefs schema version the app understands and migrates forward.

playerNames.description: Map of seat id ("1"/"2") to a custom display name (string).

score.description: Win tally for the active name pair.

pair.description: Map of seat id to the name the wins belong to (string).

wins.description: Map of seat id to a win count (non-negative integer).

autoSave.description: Whether the board is auto-saved to localStorage between sessions.

playerType.description: Map of seat id to who controls it. Expected values (advisory - the app ignores unknown ones): "human", "random", "tutor", "shark".

sharkDepth.description: Map of seat id to Shark search depth. Expected values (advisory): 2 (Easy), 3 (Medium), 4 (Hard).

tutorLevel.description: Map of seat id to Tutor difficulty. Expected values (advisory): "easy", "medium".

randomLevel.description: Map of seat id to Random difficulty. Expected values (advisory): "easy", "medium".

startingPlayer.description: Which seat opens the next game.

hintLightDelay.description: Hint bulb idle light-up delay in ms; 0 = always on, -1 = never.
